a: गुंफः — [गुंफ्-घञ्] 1 Tying, stringing together; गुंफो वाणीनां B. R. 1. 1. --2 Putting together, composing, arrangement. --3 A bracelet. --4 A whisker, a mustachio.
गुंफना — [गुंफ् --युच्] 1 Stringing together. --2 Arranging, composing. --3 Good adjustment (of words and their senses), good composition; वाक्ये शब्दार्थयोः सम्यग्रचना गुंफना मता.
गुंठ् — {c10c} U. (गुंठयति-ते, गुंठित) 1 To encircle, surround, envelop, enclose. --2 To hide, conceal.
गुंठनं — 1 Concealing, covering, hiding. --2 Smearing, as in भस्मगुंठनं.
गुंठित — a. 1 Surrounded, covered. --2 Pounded, ground, reduced to dust.
गुंदा(द्रा)लः — The Cātaka bird.
गुंदलः — The sound of a small oblong drum.
गुंद्र् — {c10c} P. (गुंद्रयति) To lie.
गुंद्रः — A kind of grass.

गुंजा — [गुंज्-अच्] 1 A small shrub of that name, bearing a red black berry; अंतर्विषमया (for ˚य्यः) ह्येता बहिश्चैव मनोरमाः . गुंजाफलसमाकारा योषितः केन निर्मिताः .. Pt. 1. 196; किं जातु गुंजाफलभूषणानां सुवर्णकारेण वनेचराणां Vikr. 1. 25. --2 A berry of this shrub used as a weight, measuring on an average {1} (5/16) grains Troy, or an artificial weight called Guñja measuring about {2} (3/16) grains. --3 Humming, a low murmuring sound. --4 A kettle-drum; Bk. 14. 2. --5 A tavern. --6 Reflection, meditation, --7 A kind of plant with a poisonous root.
गुंजः — 1 Humming. --2 A cluster of blossoms, bunch of flowers, a nosegay; cf. गुच्छ. --Comp. --कृत् a large black bee.
गुंजनं — Sounding low, humming, buzzing.
गुंजिका — A berry of the Guñjā plant.
गुंजितं — Huming, murmuring; स्वच्छंदं दलदरविंद ते मरंदं विंदंतो विदधतु गुंजितं मिलिंदाः Bv. 1. 15; न गुंजितं तन्न जहार यन्मनः Bk. 2. 19.

m: गुं—क्वण mfn. speaking through the nose, Gal.

a: गुंड् — {c10c} P. (गुंडयति, गुंडित) 1 To cover, hide. --2 To pound, reduce to powder.
गुंडः — [गुंड्-अच्] 1 A kind of fragrant grass. --2 Pounding, grinding.
गुंडकः — 1 Dust, powder. --2 An oil-vessel. --3 A soft or low pleasing tone. --4 Dirty flour or meal
गुंडनं — Concealing, covering, hiding.
गुंडिकः — Flour, meal, powder.
गुंडित — a. 1 Pounded, ground. --2 Covered with dust.
